Honest handymen, mechanics, and other tradesmen: How do we find you or those like you?

Former auto shop manager here. If you read yelp reviews, take it with a grain of salt. Read the both negative and positive reviews, most of the time the positive comments can be more bullshit than the bad reviews. Ask us why we recommend the service, ask for pictures or demonstration. It's okay to shop around and ask other shops for opinions. There are lots of dishonest shops out there, if they recommend something, ask a price quote but decline it. Get an oil change somewhere else and ask them to check for issues, sharing clues from the first shop. Get a second price quote. Go online, research it to know what's involved.
Ask other people in similar industries. If you want a good carpenter then ask plumbers or electricians. They all will be working side by side, but have no actual ties to each other.
You don't. We keep a low profile for a reason.
